tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary shall carry out a comprehensive national program, including advertising and media awareness, to inform consumers about—

children.text: the need to reduce energy consumption during the 4-year period beginning on August 8, 2005;
the benefits to consumers of reducing consumption of electricity, natural gas, and petroleum, particularly during peak use periods;
the importance of low energy costs to economic growth and preserving manufacturing jobs in the United States; and
practical, cost-effective measures that consumers can take to reduce consumption of electricity, natural gas, and gasoline, including—
maintaining and repairing heating and cooling ducts and equipment;

tree.heading: Cooperation
tree.text: The program carried out under subsection (a) shall—

children.text: include collaborative efforts with State and local government officials and the private sector; and
incorporate, to the maximum extent practicable, successful State and local public education programs.

tree.heading: Report
tree.text: Not later than July 1, 2009, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report describing the effectiveness of the program under this section.

tree.heading: Termination of authority
tree.text: The program carried out under this section shall terminate on December 31, 2010.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $90,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2006 through 2010.
